shared_criteria: For each applicable Marco, assess Coverage, Coherence and Consequence with source-backed evidence; an event count, elapsed time or blank checklist cannot substitute.
Trace each claimed change to an actual played event, a valid source and the relevant authority; UNKNOWN remains visible.
Evaluate whether the protagonist had meaningful agency, alternatives and consequences without requiring one moral answer or a predetermined transformation.
Record unresolved causal debts and their owner/next legitimate resolution; open threads do not automatically block a truthful graduation unless a chosen target or authority requires resolution.
Assess continuity to the chosen horizon using sourced time and state; distinguish established, changed, lost, absent and UNKNOWN relationships.
Keep operational transition to the main 2010 chronicle separate from documentary graduation review and from scene readiness.

ROUTE-VAMPIRE-BY-2010: An actual Embrace is caused by play, authorized, narrated and persisted; no planned date, sire, cause or success is assumed.

Post-Embrace play contains consequential lived experience of changed body, Hunger/Beast, moral cost, social exposure and power under the then-current rule source; coverage is demonstrated by events and choices, not a prescribed scene count.
All mechanical traits are supported by the current rule source, actual acquisition, player authorization and reconciled ledger; target-sheet entries alone do not qualify.
2010 state and relationships are evidenced; survival, memory, status, lineage and continuity are not assumed.
ROUTE-NONVAMPIRIC-2010: The player expressly approves the alternate target; approval does not rewrite a prior target silently.
The actual mortal or other authorized state, relationships and 2010 continuity are evidenced; no vampire-only trait is granted.
ROUTE-UNFINISHED-OR-EARLY-TERMINAL: Refusal, failure, absence, death or unfinished status is reported only if caused by actual play or explicit player choice and persisted where required.
A truthful terminal or unfinished result may fail the selected target; do not relabel it as successful graduation or add plot armor.
ROUTE-EXTENDED-OR-PAUSED-HORIZON: Identify the actual plausibility or timing conflict and present its consequences for player decision.
No extension or target-window change occurs by silence or convenience.
